messages:
maya_sales: Heads-up 1 Santek wants to POC a custom conversational model (santek-chat-14b) + a 4-bit quant. Needs KV cache support, p50 < 200ms, and enterprise controls (SAML, KMS). They asked for a capacity/pricing estimate for ~120k tokens/day. Any blockers?
diego_se: Do we have the artifact format (GGUF vs HF) and tokenizer? Any custom ops or compiled kernels?
client_rep: They'll provide HF checkpoint and a GGUF export. tokenizer.json included. No custom CUDA ops.
tess_infra: 4-bit ok usually. We'll run a compat scan to see if optimized kernels are used. Need a short prompt set and a representative conversation to emulate KV cache hits.
liya_security: Security: confirm data flow (do convos land in Redwood?), requirement for SAML SSO, and KMS/HSM constraints. Also ask for SOC2 report.
client_rep: Convos stored in Santek's secure bucket. They want Redwood-managed KV cache but encrypted with their KMS. SOC2 link coming.
diego_se: On variants: recommend we request (1) fp16 HF tarball, (2) 4-bit GGUF, (3) a distilled 7B fallback. That gives low-latency fallback.
tess_infra: I'll kick off scan. Commands: `redwood scan-compat --model-url <url> --out=scan.json` and then `redwood bench --mode=latency --bs=1`. Need artifact URL + prompts.
ci-bot: [ci] compat-scan job queued: job=santek-cs-8076543210-1 runner=dev-infer-04
maya_sales: timeline: can we get a compatibility + latency sketch in 48hrs? They want pricing to decide reserved capacity next week.
tess_infra: I'll aim for initial numbers within 36h. Kernel work adds time.
liya_security: Once SOC2 and KMS policy received I'll fill questionnaire and loop legal for any non-standard asks.
maya_sales: Great. Client will upload artifacts today; I'll post links when available. Thanks team.
